proposition.claim:
The final displayed chain-rule equality includes +(1-r)^(-3) d/dt E A_t^2.

Gamma_r=(1+t)A_t=A_t/(1-r), with t=r/(1-r). The statement is used for an isotropic log-concave initial probability measure.
